dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline curvature along the posterior trailing edge, transitioning from a wide base to a narrow, backward-leaning upper section.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius forming a smooth, non-acute peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate angular steepness along the anterior margin, sloping at approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the inferred horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The visible longitudinal base width is approximately 1.8 times the maximum vertical height of the fin structure.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible superficial linear rake marks or scratches on the mid-to-lower lateral surface of the fin; numerous transient water droplets are distributed across the dermis.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct light-toned vertical/diagonal striation or narrow pigment patch is visible in the lower posterior quadrant of the fin body.
